item.title: Wild Trade Rumors: Minnesota Could Trade Defenceman for Forward Help
item.description: The Minnesota Wild are all-in this season. After acquiring former Norris trophy winner Quinn Hughes, it sounds like GM Bill Guerin isn't finished.The Wild are a Stanley Cup contender this season and now with Hughes in the mix, they could turn their blueline depth into some help for their middle-six. item.title: 3 Sabres' Trade Candidates With New GM in Buffalo
item.description: The Buffalo Sabres made headlines on Monday as they've let go GM Kevyn Adams. It's been nothing but disappointing season after disappointing season, and ownership, and more importantly their fan base, had seen enough.The Sabres announced Adams was out and Jarmo Kekalainen, who joined the franchise as a senior adviser in May, was promoted as Adams' replacement. item.title: Sabres Rumors: Lindy Ruff to be replaced in Buffalo
item.description: The Buffalo Sabres are making drastic changes, and it could seep behind the bench as well. There's several rumors flying around after Kevyn Adams was fired, that head coach Lindy Ruff is next.The only thing is, Ruff won't be fired, and will be reportedly moved into a management role, and stay with the franchise he's been part of for most of his hockey career.
